notes.title: Celebrate the One-Year Anniversary of RUINSMAGUS - On Sale for a Limited Time
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259826/65299525544971ef33fc16fc6be10025fc8ba4fc.png[/img]

Greetings, everyone.

Today marks the one-year anniversary of RUINSMAGUS, and we are taking this time to recognize the community and give thanks to all of the seasoned explorers and new adventurers who have played the game and joined the prestigious RUINSMAGUS guild. Our appreciation also extends to everyone else who has supported us along the way. Be it a like or a share on social media, your support has been that extra boost of HP to keep us in the fight and help make the game a success – we truly could not have done it without you.

In addition to some stunning new artwork to commemorate this milestone, those who’ve yet to experience this epic first-person VR RPG can grab RUINSMAGUS on sale for [b]30% off for a limited time[/b]. 

[b]But that’s not all! [/b]

We at CharacterBank and Mastiff are super excited to let you know that we have even [i]more[/i] exciting RUINSMAGUS news coming soon. We can't wait to unveil what we have in store, so please stay tuned to official channels for further updates.

Thank you for being a vital part of our community, and again, thank you for helping us make RUINSMAGUS a success. Your support is invaluable and means the world to us, and we're looking forward to continuing to bring you all the best gaming experiences.

Quest on,
Your Friends at CharacterBank and Mastiff

notes.title: FREE UPDATE - The Remix Update is Live!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Citizens of Grand Amnis rejoice! The “Remix Update” is live![/b][/h3]

This major update includes free, optional English voiceover, updated translations, and per fan request, late-game dungeons have been remixed for a fresh gameplay experience.

Watch the new Remix Update trailer for a glimpse at the new content and to hear samples of the new English voiceover cast:

[previewyoutube=_tK2sdHp6Zc;full][/previewyoutube]

The English voice cast was selected for their unique talents and abilities that further aid in creating a cohesive and immersive fantasy world and include AmaLee (Dragon Ball, Xenoverse 2, Girls' Frontline) as the game’s heroine, Iris, Cristina Vee (Puella Magi Madoka Magica, Hyperdimension Neptunia, RWBY) as Euridice and Reese Seption, Todd Haberkon (My Hero Academia, Ben 10, Transformers: War for Cybertron Trilogy) as Mr. Shopkeeper, Roger Rose as the game’s Guild Master, and many other highly-talented voice actors. 

In addition, “The Warrior and the Tailor” DLC for RUINSMAGUS will also be updated
with an optional English voiceover, which sees David Shatraw as the voice of
Schneider, the mysterious tailor.
 
For the complete English voiceover cast list and the full Remix Update changelog, please visit www.ruinsmagus.com.

In celebration of this update, CharacterBank Inc. has placed RUINSMAGUS on sale for a limited time. New fans can experience the definitive VR RPG action-adventure dungeon crawler in a brand new way.

Current owners: To receive this free major update, please ensure your game has been updated to the latest version.

If you'd like to learn more about RUINSMAGUS, please visit the game’s official website at [url=https://character-bank.com/ruinsmagus/]www.RUINSMAGUS.com[/url] and follow along on Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/ruinsmagus_en]@ruinsmagus_en[/url].


We thank you for your support and hope that you enjoy the game.



- Your friends at Character Bank and Mastiff

notes.title: Additional English Voice Cast Revealed as Part of Forthcoming "Remix Update"
notes.notes:
Good morrow, friends. 

It’s another gorgeous day here in Grand Amnis. We trust you’ve been enjoying your stay. We highly recommend stopping by the café for some tasty treats if you haven't already. 
Afterward, visit Schneider, the mysterious tailor[b]*[/b], for some new digs. And from there, it’s off on another exciting adventure!

We're back to deliver [b]more[/b] English voice cast reveals that will be a part of the free “Remix Update” coming later this spring. The major update will include several great features and fixes and adds full English voiceover support!

We [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1701560/view/3714947226172936153]recently revealed[/url] that AmaLee, Cristina Vee, and Todd Haberkon are joining the English voice cast. Adding to that already power-packed list, we are thrilled to announce the next group of English voice actors to be included in the “Remix Update”:

[list]
[*] Damien Haas ([i]Fortnite, Fire Emblem series, So Random![/i]) as Baal Brundore and Schneider
[*] David Shatraw ([i]Titus, Cobra Kai, Hello Neighbor: Welcome to Raven Brooks[/i]) as Rogue and Magi-David
[*] Erica Mendez ([i]Genshin Impact, KILL la KILL, Hunter x Hunter[/i]) as Orfeo and Cafe Staff
[*] Roger Rose ([i]Metal Gear series, Assassin's Creed series, Batman: The Brave and the Bold, The Powerpuff Girls[/i]) as the Guild Master
[/list]

A complete English voiceover cast list and the full "Remix Update" changelog will be available when the update goes live. 

[i]But when you ask?[/i]

Novice and experienced Magi alike won't need to wait much longer to enjoy this free update as the "Remix Update" will be released [b]later this month![/b] 

If you'd like to learn more about RUINSMAGUS, please visit the game’s official website at [url=https://character-bank.com/ruinsmagus/]www.RUINSMAGUS.com[/url] and follow along on Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/ruinsmagus_en]@ruinsmagus_en[/url].



===== 

[b]*[/b] “The Warrior and the Tailor” add-on content required.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2161300/RUINSMAGUS__The_Warrior_and_the_Tailor/

notes.title: RUINSMAGUS Updated to 1.1.3, Soundtrack Now Available and More!
notes.notes:
Hey there Magi!

This is CharacterBank Inc., the developers behind RUINSMAGUS!

We hope everyone had an amazing New Year! CharacterBank Inc., launched a patch before the holidays, so we wanted to let everyone know what was in it and some general updates!

[h2]▼bHaptics Support[/h2]

・bHaptics is now supported. You can literally feel the magic and each spell has a unique pattern. It’s the most immersive way to play! Learn more by watching the video below.

[previewyoutube=xy0mR5PjpM4;full]https://youtu.be/xy0mR5PjpM4[/previewyoutube]

[h2]▼Patch Notes[/h2]

▼RUINSMAGUS Base Game

・We went through and optimized the whole game! Now RUINSMAGUS should have a performance boost when playing for longer sessions!

・Loading time has been reduced!
・Other minor bugs and issues were fixed!


[h2]▼DLC『The Warrior and the Tailor』[/h2]

・A save issue where costumes were not carried over between saves has been resolved.

[h2]▼The Official Soundtrack Has Been Released! [/h2]

During the last week of December we also released the official soundtrack for RUINSMAGUS. Players can purchase it seperately, or purchase the RUINSMAGUS complete bundle to get a special discount on RUINSMAGUS, The Warrior and the Tailor and the soundtrack! 

[h2]▼But wait...there's more...? [/h2]

In other news, we have started [url=https://twitter.com/CharacterBankEN]an English account[/url] for CharacterBank Inc.! We will be posting updates on RUINSMAGUS and other projects there, so please keep an eye out! 2023 will be an exciting year for VR, and CharacterBank Inc. We are excited to showcase our future projects and to continue to work with VR and XR.

In addition, the English voice acting for RUINSMAGUS is scheduled for release in Q1 2023! We will have more information to share very soon. I’m sure everyone will love our picks for the cast ;).

notes.title: RUINSMAGUS Has Been Updated to 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hey there Magi!

This is CharacterBank Inc., the developers behind RUINSMAGUS!

We wanted to let everyone know some of the changes that have been included with the latest update and the DLC content for RUINSMAGUS, “The Warrior and the Tailor”. 
Please check out our previous post for more information about the free update and the DLC content.

[h2]▼Patch Notes[/h2]

▼RUINSMAGUS Base Game

・The strengths of various spells have been adjusted

・Fixed a bug where enemies wouldn’t attack

・The amount of rewards for completing a quest has been tweaked

・The price of items in the shop have been adjusted

[h2]▼DLC『The Warrior and the Tailor』[/h2]

・Fixed a bug that prevented information explaining the conditions for unlocking Iris’ costumes from being displayed
　Players will need to obtain S Rank in the main scenario to unlock new costumes for Iris. The costumes can be purchased from the tailor shop in the City Center.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259826/71e387d1bfaaa917255272a0bfd2d3fe47c202a4.png[/img]
・The conditions for acquiring each of Iris’ costumes have been modified to be displayed.

notes.title: Now Available: Side Story DLC AND Free Content Update!
notes.notes:
Magi, 

We have 3 exciting updates for you! 

[h2]“The Warrior and the Tailor” DLC[/h2]
Ready for a new area, side story, boss fight, and 5 unique Iris outfits? The [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2161300/RUINSMAGUS__The_Warrior_and_the_Tailor/]RUINSMAGUS[/url][/i] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2161300/RUINSMAGUS__The_Warrior_and_the_Tailor/]DLC[/url] is now available for purchase! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259826/5e7499eb27b96a3877391fdc60d165a852c2b82d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259826/abd9d096affff2fbb2491a6dfccb2432ca1d7a0b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259826/cd0a80cf99ac99a4dcafd0b87043a45e01355679.png[/img]

https://youtu.be/X9MrT6HyqRk

Put your skills to the test and see how long you can withstand the “Meister’s Abyss” [b]survival mode[/b], where you’ll face waves of challenging enemies. The only hope for survival is being prepared – upgrade your loadout between waves and even summon a character from the story to join the fight (including everyone’s favorite companion, Iris!). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259826/935b3237e907e5f37c200576bab185d1ec0ceb6a.png[/img]

Since [i]RUINSMAGUS'[/i] release, we have received countless requests for English voiceovers. We’re thrilled to say they have been heard and are soon to be a reality: [i]RUINSMAGUS[/i] will have an English voiceover as a [b]free[/b] update in [b]early 2023[/b]! The cast is chosen and recording now. We’ll have another update when there’s more news to share :)

Happy Holidays, Magi!

notes.title: The Adventure Continues in RUINSMAGUS This Year!
notes.notes:
Hey there Magi!

CharacterBank Inc. is proud to announce that we are working on a major update of RUINSMAGUS, slated to release later this year! First off, watch the trailer to see the first sneak peek!

[previewyoutube=iLswdcWorrg;full][/previewyoutube]

The world of Grand Amnis will expand with both paid and free DLC. In the free update, players will have the opportunity to revisit old missions on the Quest Board, and face waves of enemies in a brand-new dungeon. 

The paid update will introduce brand new story content, featuring a mysterious new swordsman set in a new location. Iris' job description is updated as she adds fashionista to her resume! Players will be able to unlock all sorts of costumes, giving you more options as you revisit the heartwarming story of RUINSMAGUS! Players can get a sneak peak of this DLC by downloading the TGSVR app. Find out more information on [url=https://tgsvr.com/]the official TGSVR website[/url].

There is still more to discuss...like how we are also working on an English dub of RUINSMAGUS! No more subs vs. dubs wars! CharacterBank Inc. is also looking at increasing the compatibility of RUINSMAGUS with other VR headsets such as WMR devices. More information about all of these updates and more will be shared at a later point in time. 

To mark the occasion, the game will be discounted by 20% on Steam September 14 - 19!

Check out more screenshots of the update by visiting the official RUINSMAGUS website. What are you looking forward to the most? Let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: RUINSMAGUS x Tokyo Game Show 2022!
notes.notes:
[b]We have pushed a minor update to RUINSMAGUS![/b]

This update fixes a number of minor bugs that have been brought to our attention. The full patch notes will be at the bottom of this post. In addition, this brings RUINSMAGUS on par with other versions of the game (hence skipping 1.0.2!).

Please update to the latest version for the best experience.

As a reminder, [b]we will be presenting at Tokyo Game Show [/b]which starts on September 15th and goes until the 18th. If you happen to make it to the show, please come by our booth in the Indie Games Area! We are looking forward to meeting all of our fans!

If you can't make it to Tokyo, don't worry. [b]We will also have a presence at TGSVR[/b], a free app that can be downloaded to enjoy a unique VR experience from Tokyo Game Show. For more information, please check out the official [url=https://tgsvr.com/en/]TGS VR Website[/url].

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made adjustments to how the game handles "out of bounds" in order to improve the gameplay experience.
[*] Other minor improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1701560/view/3382785191073054384
